title: Jesus at the Feast of Dedication
keywords: I and the Father are one
description: During the Feast of Dedication in Jerusalem, Jesus walks in Solomon's Colonnade, and the Jews demand that he plainly state whether he is the Messiah. Jesus points to his works and declares that he and the Father are one. The Jews pick up stones to stone him for blasphemy, but he escapes and goes across the Jordan to the place where John first baptized, where many come to believe in him.
